cambodia.title: Flag of the Kingdom of Cambodia

colors.note: Represents the monarchy, country, and royal authority
Represents the nation and its people
The depiction of Angkor Wat represents religion and the nation's heritage

desc:
- Three horizontal bands of blue, red (double width), and blue with a white silhouette of Angkor Wat centred on the red band
- Readopted on 30 June 1993 after the restoration of the monarchy, reviving the pre-1970 royal flag
trivia:
- Cambodia is the only national flag that features a building in its design
- The Angkor Wat temple has appeared on every Cambodian flag since 1863 in various forms
- The current design dates originally from 1948, briefly discontinued between 1970 and 1993
